svg.aria-label: The outline-only mode, simple view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources, optional (stop); Structure architect (agent); Outline approval (stop) | paper: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist: each source confirmed by a live lookup (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1 (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge jobs, started by the session at once: a leads job per theme run, the intersections and the venues (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, citation rounds started by the session over the merged core set: refs and cited-by in jobs of at most 40 works, until the citation loop closes, at most 8 (agent, only when needed); The citation loop does not close: another 8 rounds, or go on with the works named (stop); Literature strategist, merge run, after the merge jobs: removes the duplicates, runs the quality gates, writes the one review (agent, only when needed); You review the sources, optional (stop); Planner: outline and argument map (agent); Literature strategist: the sections with no source (agent, only when needed); Planner: assigns what was found (agent, only when needed); Outline approval (stop).
